known_limitations: Philox KAT vectors and the citation path tests/kat_vectors are from memory, not from a downloaded file.
Survival retries beyond retry 0 are generated only when a rejection occurs; every draw is still addressable by (block, update, draw, retry). Rejection probability per draw is below 2^-25.

The C++ collision audit enumerates seven representative blocks and survival retries 0-3. Coverage of all blocks and retries rests on counters carrying block, update and retry verbatim, which is checked.
The paired-cell part of the C++ collision audit is structural: counter functions take no arm, law, start or label argument. The Python checker enumerates per cell from the config schema.
The 16 absolute cell-mean records carry no inferential bound, because none is frozen. They are labelled descriptive.
The secondary 'relation to allele enrichment' label (AGREEMENT/DISAGREEMENT/UNCERTAINTY) uses an implementation-defined descriptive mapping that must be reviewed. It cannot alter any decision.
Analyzer validation is strict, and any mismatch is a terminal INVALID after production. An analyzer bug found only after production would close the route.
The production driver refuses if projected output exceeds 50 GiB, half the 100 GiB ceiling. Projected output is 3,299,274,752 bytes (about 3.07 GiB), derived from the fixed record counts and sizes.
Job accounting (sacct) and the delivery manifest are collected after the job by the reviewer, not by the template.
std::filesystem on GCC 8 needs -lstdc++fs; unsigned __int128 is used only for an optional fixture cross-check.
